cross_chapter_interface: Government G in c08 IS-LM is consumption and government investment is absent; all capital formation belongs to I.

Exact ordinary gross factors precede log/first-order relations. C07 uses total log inflation with target2 and a supplied reference-output path; c08 finite NK uses zero target, nominal steady lograte2, natural-rate deviation and shock-specific flexible-price output.
C07 prior-information inflation forecasts are distinguished from c08 forward next-period forecasts and finite terminal conditions.
C05 matching bargaining and effort wage models are separate environments; they are not silently combined.
